svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 05 · Los Angeles · 05/12 Sculpture Garden (Uncommon)
svg.desc: A shady lawn on the north side of campus. Take the long way to class through it. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
